$comment: Guard corpus (helpdesk v5 Parts B, D, H). Each case: the guarded field, what the learner wrote (decides the script, the zh / en limit and the template variant), the model's text, and the expected result: "passed" or the first guard reason. Explanation cases also carry the shown answer they must be grounded in. guard.spec.ts runs every case; CI runs it with no model.
